limits: No injuries, rest or travel in the replay
Recent form uses full shot data; live it uses box-score shots until a 2026 shot file is loaded

market.summary: 2025-26 regular season, 1,309 games, closing moneylines with the bookmaker's cut removed. Picking winners it's a tie; the market is slightly sharper on probabilities. Flat 1-unit bets at the closing price by how far Lockski was above the market:
market.note: One season only; the betting results are within normal luck. Bigger gaps did worse.
